$comment: MODE = dark. Neutrals only. This is Confetti's dark look and the fallback for any theme that doesn't bring its own — COOL CHARCOAL ON TRUE BLACK: the page is #000 and the content surfaces are a cool charcoal above it, with cool off-white text and the brand red left as the one warm thing on the page. Light mode is warm cream paper; the two modes are deliberately different temperatures rather than one being a tinted copy of the other. A black page is what makes the rest work: at zero luminance, page → card separation costs nothing, so the content surfaces can sit deep enough for a saturated brand red to clear AA on them. Subtle accent tints deepen (X.700) so the light foreground reads on them; the hover shadow repoints to chalk, since a dark shadow on a dark surface reads as nothing. Emitted under [data-mode='dark'].

backdrop.comment: recessed mat below page — but page is now true black, so in Confetti dark this collapses to the same #000. Anything that relied on backdrop reading darker than page (the Modal story's app frame) has to separate with a border instead. The role is kept because other themes inheriting this mode still have somewhere below their page to go.

color.$comment-status: STATUS roles — see the note in modes/light.json. Only `text` moves between modes: the rich green FILL carries its white label at 5.34:1 on any page, but the same green AS TEXT drops to 2.43:1 on the card surface, so it lifts to green.400 here.

subtle.comment: the tint end goes deep in dark, like the accent tints

text.comment: danger AS TEXT — stays on the palest red HERE, on the mode axis, because a theme inheriting this mode may have surfaces much lighter than Confetti's. Adventure's `card` is #35492f and Neon's is #2e1650; red.300 fails on both. Confetti's dark override takes it down to red.300, which its deep charcoal can afford.

deep.comment: the hazard stripe on a danger control

on-bold.comment: bold hues stay light in dark mode, so the deepest graphite reads on them

on-subtle.comment: subtle tints are deep in dark mode — needs the light foreground

button-lift.comment: button hover shadow — separate from card so a theme can drop or swap it
